statement.zh: 拉格什本城（Tell al-Hiba）与吉尔苏（特罗）是拉格什城邦网络中的不同遗址，不应在档案中混为同一点。
statement.en: Lagash city proper (Tell al-Hiba) and Girsu (Tello) are distinct sites within the Lagash polity network and must not be collapsed into one locus in the archive.

editorial.notes: Fact about site distinction as oriented in registered surveys/syntheses.
